name: Maraapunisaurus
sum: Maraapunisaurus is a sauropod from the Late Jurassic Morrison Formation of the United States, known from one lost vertebra and sometimes estimated to be the largest dinosaur.
wsnote: Size estimates vary widely because they rest on a 1878 description of a single lost bone; some analyses suggest the figures are over-estimates (Wikipedia revision).
holotype: A single vertebral neural arch known only from Cope's description and drawing; the bone is lost.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Carpenter 2018
